capture.scope: Every emitted raw producer frame before Master; stereo equality and finite values, scalar aggregates only.
capture.injection: HTTP-only registerProcessor subclass calls original process() unchanged, then scans its output. No per-chip-cycle JavaScript wrapper.
capture.timing: Original core-render timer excludes added scan; Date.now may be coarse. Window deltas, lifetime max and load timing are reported separately.
capture.memory: WASM linear-memory byte lengths at capture boundaries only; not allocation occupancy or JS heap/leak analysis.

interpretation: Bounded real-file execution, not listening approval, whole-song/corpus compatibility, glitch-free playback or hardware accuracy. Failures and silence are retained; no execution-based replacement.
